note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。 無次元x∈[0,1]、両端u=0、中心差分の内点31/63/127。零解から固定ds=0.1で80step。λ=2で上下枝を補正し、λ=4は離散無解の意図的な対照です。擬似弧長は物理時間ではありません。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures. Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time.

name.en: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.
